minimum_review: diff review for SKILL.md, agents/**/*.md, scripts/*.py, evals/evals.json, plugin.json, PACKAGE_SURFACE.json, RELEASE_LOCK.json
no unreviewed runtime surface expansion
PASS-SCOPED is acceptable only when live Claude Code runtime was not available and that gap is recorded
formal artifact runs must produce certificate.json, gate markdown, invocation ledger, and transcript; role-equivalent general-purpose fallback is not a perfect formal invocation
formal artifact runs require trace-authenticated native Agent/Task tool-use events for PASS-TRACKED; declared ledgers alone cap at PASS-SCOPED
review AUDIT_REPORT.md, STABLE_RELEASE_MANIFEST.json, and release-lock idempotence evidence before reuse
verify STABLE_RELEASE_MANIFEST.json self_hash_sha256 and file_inventory hashes after unpacking

review formal_runner_contract_results.json for mismatched ids, nested fake results, result-before-call ordering, duplicate ids, empty/generic results, and description-only lane mentions before promoting runtime claims
review gate_contract_results.json for uppercase/mixed-case URI-scheme evidence refs and scheme-like evidence-ref rejection
review formal_runner_contract_results.json for nested/result-before-call trace false-world cases before promoting runtime claims
review gate_contract_results.json for uppercase/mixed-case URI-scheme evidence-ref rejection before trusting strict local evidence claims

review formal_runner_contract_results.json for nested_tool_result_inside_tool_input_does_not_authenticate, tool_result_before_tool_use_does_not_authenticate, and structured_subagent_type_exact_match_required before promoting runtime claims

review gate_contract_results.json for uppercase_https_evidence_ref_rejected, mixed_case_https_evidence_ref_rejected, uppercase_doi_urn_refs_rejected, and scheme_like_evidence_ref_rejected_in_strict_mode

review formal_runner_contract_results.json for text/message masquerade, unexpected Agent/Task calls without required structured selectors, nested fake results, result-before-call ordering, duplicate ids, empty/generic results, and mismatched ids before promoting runtime claims
review gate_contract_results.json for URI-scheme evidence refs and URI-scheme artifact_path rejection in strict local evidence mode

do not promote to PASS-TRACKED unless a live official Claude Code stream-json transcript contains authentic tool_use/tool_result event types with exact native ntt-* selectors and matching post-call results

review formal_runner_contract_results.json for tool_use_inside_tool_result_content_does_not_authenticate, tool_result_inside_tool_result_content_does_not_authenticate, fake_tool_use_and_result_inside_tool_result_content_does_not_authenticate, and tool_use_inside_tool_use_content_does_not_authenticate before promoting runtime claims

review gate_contract_results.json for duplicate_false_world_test_id_does_not_satisfy_minimum, duplicated_false_world_test_object_does_not_satisfy_minimum, aliased_same_false_world_test_evidence_counted_once, and duplicate_true_world_test_id_rejected before trusting modal coverage claims
review formal_runner_contract_results.json for data/payload/delta event-smuggling cases and role-inverted tool-use/tool-result cases before promoting runtime claims
review gate_contract_results.json for wrong target_claim, missing modal test ID, wildcard applies_to_tests, and target_claim_ids list cases before trusting modal coverage claims
do not promote to PASS-TRACKED unless tool_use events are assistant-origin and matching tool_result events are user-origin when role context is available
review release provenance hygiene output; bundled audit/self-validation artifacts must not contain stale package-root names or machine-local build paths
treat this package as a deliberately closed-surface validator, not as a comprehensive validator for every Claude Code plugin surface supported by the platform
review derived_or_downstream_claims records; downstream/deployment/safety/action-authorizing conclusions must not inherit pass status from source claims
reject active self-certificate package-version provenance that disagrees with plugin.json, except for explicitly historical patch notes outside the active certificate

for any PASS-TRACKED promotion, require PASS_TRACKED_UPGRADE_AUDIT.md, an external audit bundle, live fixture evidence, formal artifact trace authentication, official validator outputs, promotion_certificate.json, and certify_pass_tracked_upgrade.py output
review docs/**/*.md and self_validation/README.md; GitHub-facing README files must remain documentation-only and outside plugin-loadable runtime component directories
required_commands:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
text = "\n".join(p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") for p in Path("self_validation").rglob("*") if p.is_file())
tokens = [
    "/" + "mnt" + "/" + "data",
    "/" + "home" + "/" + "oai",
    "ntt_v07" + "12_work",
    "ntt_v07" + "11_work",
    "nozickian-truth-tracking-agentic-v" + "0.7." + "12",
    "nozickian-truth-tracking-agentic-v" + "0.7." + "11",
    "v07" + "12_targeted_probe_results",
    "v07" + "11_targeted_probe_results",
]
for token in tokens:
    assert token not in text, token
PY
v1.0.1_patch_notes: Regenerated bundled self-validation outputs for v1.0.1 and normalized machine-local build paths out of release artifacts.
validate_package.py now performs release-provenance hygiene checks over bundled audit/self-validation artifacts.
The false-world mutation suite now rejects stale generated self-validation artifact provenance.
The release-lock command chain includes an explicit grep-style stale-provenance guard.
Release remains PASS-SCOPED pending live official Claude Code runtime traces and optional official validators.
STANDARD.md now names no automatic epistemic closure/downstream transmission as a first-class rule.
certificate-template.json and the active self-certificate include derived_or_downstream_claims records.
ntt_gate.py rejects downstream auto-pass/status inheritance when derived_or_downstream_claims records attempt closure without an independent claim record.
validate_package.py rejects stale active self-certificate package-version provenance such as old regenerated-package producer strings.
Add PASS_TRACKED_UPGRADE_AUDIT.md and certify_pass_tracked_upgrade.py so a Claude Code runtime environment can machine-check PASS-SCOPED to PASS-TRACKED promotion bundles.
Add a comprehensive GitHub README documentation tree under docs/ and a self_validation README without expanding the plugin runtime surface.
